chest.definition: The upper front part of the trunk between neck and abdomen.
chest.exampleUsage: The chest houses the heart and lungs behind the ribcage.

ribcage.definition: The skeletal framework formed by the ribs protecting internal chest organs.
ribcage.exampleUsage: The ribcage protects the vital organs within the chest.

abdomen.definition: The region of the body between the chest and the pelvis.
abdomen.exampleUsage: The abdomen contains major digestive organs.

belly.definition: The everyday term for the front surface of the abdomen.
belly.exampleUsage: Belly is an everyday word for the abdominal region.

navel.definition: The small central abdominal indentation marking the former umbilical cord site.
navel.exampleUsage: The navel marks the center of the abdomen.

waist.definition: The narrower part of the human torso between the ribs and the hips.
waist.exampleUsage: The waist lies between the lower ribs and the pelvic hips.

sternum.definition: The long flat central bone forming the middle of the chest; breastbone.
sternum.exampleUsage: The sternum connects the ribs at the center of the chest.

breast.definition: The front anterior tissue of the chest.
breast.exampleUsage: The breast is situated on the anterior upper chest.

collarbone.definition: The horizontal bone linking the sternum to the shoulder; clavicle.
collarbone.exampleUsage: The collarbone links the breastbone with the shoulder blade.

adam-s-apple.definition: The visible front projection of thyroid cartilage on the human neck.
adam-s-apple.exampleUsage: The Adam’s apple is visible at the front of the throat.

shoulder.definition: The joint connecting the arm to the trunk of the body.
shoulder.exampleUsage: The shoulder joint allows a wide range of arm motion.

armpit.definition: The hollow area beneath the junction of the arm and the shoulder.
armpit.exampleUsage: The armpit is the hollow area under the shoulder joint.

upper-arm.definition: The section of the arm between the shoulder joint and the elbow.
upper-arm.exampleUsage: The upper arm contains the bicep and tricep muscles.

bicep.definition: The prominent two-headed muscle at the front of the upper arm.
bicep.exampleUsage: The bicep contracts to bend the elbow joint.

tricep.definition: The large three-headed muscle at the back of the upper arm.
tricep.exampleUsage: The tricep straightens the arm at the elbow.

elbow.definition: The hinge joint between the upper arm and the forearm.
elbow.exampleUsage: The elbow allows the arm to bend and extend.

forearm.definition: The segment of the upper limb extending from elbow to wrist.
forearm.exampleUsage: The forearm connects the elbow joint to the wrist.

wrist.definition: The joint connecting the hand with the forearm.
wrist.exampleUsage: The wrist allows flexible movement of the hand.

arm.definition: The entire upper limb of the human body from shoulder to hand.
arm.exampleUsage: The arm reaches outward to lift and carry objects.

deltoid.definition: The triangular muscle covering the rounded contour of the shoulder.
deltoid.exampleUsage: The deltoid muscle lifts the arm away from the body.

upper-back.definition: The upper posterior region of the torso below the neck.
upper-back.exampleUsage: The upper back includes the shoulder blades and upper spine.

mid-back.definition: The middle posterior region of the torso along the ribcage.
mid-back.exampleUsage: The mid-back aligns with the thoracic vertebrae.

lower-back.definition: The lumbar region of the back situated between ribs and pelvis.
lower-back.exampleUsage: Good posture helps support the lower back.

spine.definition: The flexible vertical column of vertebrae supporting the torso.
spine.exampleUsage: The spine supports the weight and posture of the body.

shoulder-blade.definition: The large flat triangular bone at the back of the shoulder; scapula.
shoulder-blade.exampleUsage: The shoulder blade moves smoothly along the upper back.

rib.definition: One of the curved paired bones enclosing the thoracic chest cavity.
rib.exampleUsage: A rib curves outward from the spine around the chest.

vertebra.definition: One of the individual interlocking bony segments forming the spine.
vertebra.exampleUsage: Each vertebra is cushioned by an intervertebral disc.

tailbone.definition: The small triangular bone at the very base of the spine; coccyx.
tailbone.exampleUsage: The tailbone sits at the lower termination of the spine.

pelvis.definition: The basin-shaped complex of bones supporting the spine and legs.
pelvis.exampleUsage: The pelvis provides a stable base for the torso.

hip.definition: The ball-and-socket joint and area connecting the trunk and thigh.
hip.exampleUsage: The hip joint bears the weight of the upper body.

pectoral.definition: Relating to or naming the large muscles covering the chest.
pectoral.exampleUsage: The pectoral muscles cover the front surface of the chest.

abdominal.definition: Relating to the muscular wall and internal organs of the abdomen.
abdominal.exampleUsage: The abdominal muscles stabilize and support the trunk.

oblique.definition: The side abdominal muscles running diagonally along the flank.
oblique.exampleUsage: The oblique muscles assist in twisting the torso.

trapezius.definition: The broad diamond-shaped muscle covering upper back and neck.
trapezius.exampleUsage: The trapezius muscle helps elevate and rotate the shoulder.

latissimus.definition: The large broad muscle of the middle and lower back.
latissimus.exampleUsage: The latissimus dorsi pulls the arm downward and back.

rotator-cuff.definition: A group of muscles and tendons stabilizing the shoulder joint.
rotator-cuff.exampleUsage: The rotator cuff keeps the shoulder joint secure in motion.

core.definition: The central muscle group of the torso that stabilizes the spine.
core.exampleUsage: Core muscles support stable posture and spinal balance.

flexor.definition: A muscle whose contraction bends a joint or limb.
flexor.exampleUsage: A flexor muscle decreases the angle across a joint.

extensor.definition: A muscle whose contraction extends or straightens a joint.
extensor.exampleUsage: An extensor muscle straightens a bent limb.

tendon.definition: A tough fibrous band of connective tissue joining muscle to bone.
tendon.exampleUsage: A tendon transmits muscular force directly to the bone.

skin.definition: The pliable outer organ covering and protecting the body surface.
skin.exampleUsage: Skin protects the underlying tissues from dehydration and harm.

pore.definition: A minute opening on the skin surface for sweat and oil secretion.
pore.exampleUsage: Sweat releases through microscopic pores in the skin.

freckle.definition: A small flat brownish spot on the skin caused by localized melanin.
freckle.exampleUsage: A freckle is a small harmless spot of skin pigment.

mole.definition: A small dark permanent pigmented spot on the human skin.
mole.exampleUsage: A mole is a common pigmented skin mark.

birthmark.definition: A colored mark present on the skin from birth or infancy.
birthmark.exampleUsage: The birthmark on his arm has been present since childhood.

scar.definition: A permanent mark left on the skin after a wound or incision heals.
scar.exampleUsage: A pale scar marks the spot where the old cut healed.

wrinkle.definition: A small line, ridge or crease formed in aging or folded skin.
wrinkle.exampleUsage: Gentle wrinkles formed around his eyes as he smiled.

goosebumps.definition: Temporary small bumps on the skin caused by cold or emotional chills.
goosebumps.exampleUsage: The sudden cold breeze caused goosebumps on her arms.

tan.definition: A darkening of skin tone resulting from exposure to ultraviolet light.
tan.exampleUsage: Her skin acquired a mild tan after days outdoors.

sunburn.definition: Painful reddening and inflammation of skin from excessive sun rays.
sunburn.exampleUsage: Sunscreen helps protect bare skin from painful sunburn.
